# `openinference.decision` span

**Stability:** Development

A call to a decision model, which scores or selects among candidate options provided in the request rather than generating free-form text.

`openinference.span.kind` MUST be `DECISION`.

Decision spans do not use the `llm.*` identification and token count
attributes; the `decision.*` attributes take their place.

See [Decision Spans](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/blob/main/spec/spans/decision.md).

**Span name** is not constrained. It SHOULD identify the operation.

## Attributes

| Key | Requirement level | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`decision.system`](../attributes/decision.md) | Required | string (well-known values) | The decision API ecosystem the call conforms to, i.e. which request/response shape the client speaks, as identified by the client or server instrumentation: `typesafe` for the TypeSafe System One / Jev API, `openai` for the OpenAI Decisions API. A self-hosted vLLM server answering the Jev-compatible `/v1/systemone` shape is still `typesafe`. Distinct from `decision.provider`, which says who hosts the model. The well-known values alias the matching `llm.system` values. |
| [`openinference.span.kind`](../attributes/openinference.md) | Required | string (well-known values) | The role an operation plays in an AI application. |
| [`decision.model_name`](../attributes/decision.md) | Recommended | string | The name of the decision model being utilized. Mirrors `llm.model_name` for `DECISION` spans. |
| [`decision.provider`](../attributes/decision.md) | Recommended: When the hosting provider differs from the system. | string (well-known values) | The hosting provider of the decision model: who runs the hardware that answered, e.g. `typesafe` when calling TypeSafe directly, `openai` for the OpenAI Decisions API, or the cloud or self-hosting provider for a model served elsewhere. Distinct from `decision.system`, which names the API shape. The well-known values alias the matching `llm.provider` values. |
